# Classic Helm charts

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/helm.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Helm 4.3.1**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/helm/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- An existing Helm repository; a chart directory acme/ with Chart.yaml.
- For signed charts, retain the signing public keyring for helm pull --verify.

Authentication: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.

Fresh client state: Set HELM_CONFIG_HOME, HELM_CACHE_HOME and HELM_DATA_HOME to new directories; pull into an empty working directory.

## Configure

Use a fresh configuration and cache for every independent connection check.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export HELM_CONFIG_HOME="$AW_WORK/config"
export HELM_CACHE_HOME="$AW_WORK/cache"
export HELM_DATA_HOME="$AW_WORK/data"
export HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/config/registry/config.json"
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/config/registry"
```

```sh
helm repo add aw "$AW_URL/artifactory/api/helm/$AW_REPO" --username "$AW_USER" --password "$AW_TOKEN"
helm repo update aw
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Classic Helm publication uploads the packaged chart; the server derives index.yaml. Upload a .prov file alongside its chart when signed.

```sh
helm package acme --destination "$AW_WORK/charts"
curl --fail --user "$AW_USER:$AW_TOKEN" --upload-file "$AW_WORK/charts/acme-0.1.0.tgz" "$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO/acme-0.1.0.tgz"
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. The repository alias aw refers to the selected local, remote, virtual or federated repository.

```sh
helm search repo aw/acme --versions
helm pull aw/acme --version 0.1.0 --destination "$AW_WORK/pulled"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Do not upload a handcrafted index.yaml: the server builds the native index from stored archives.
- Classic Helm and Helm OCI use different endpoints and commands.
- No --pass-credentials is used; credentials must not be forwarded to unrelated download hosts.
